SELECT join_date, COUNT(*) AS version_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys, MIN(valid_from) AS min_vf, MAX(valid_from) AS max_vf
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-22' AND DATE '2026-09-28'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH first_ver AS (
  SELECT member_id, MIN(valid_from) AS first_vf, MIN(join_date) AS min_jd, MAX(join_date) AS max_jd, COUNT(*) AS versions
  FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN min_jd = DATE '2026-09-25' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS by_join_date,
  SUM(CASE WHEN first_vf = DATE '2026-09-25' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS by_first_valid_from,
  SUM(CASE WHEN min_jd <> max_jd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inconsistent_join_dates,
  SUM(CASE WHEN min_jd = DATE '2026-09-25' AND first_vf <> min_jd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jd_not_eq_firstvf,
  SUM(CASE WHEN first_vf = DATE '2026-09-25' AND min_jd <> first_vf THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vf_not_eq_jd,
  SUM(CASE WHEN min_jd = DATE '2026-09-25' AND versions > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_version
FROM first_ver

SELECT m.home_store_id, s.store_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS members
FROM dim_member m
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = m.home_store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE m.join_date = DATE '2026-09-25' AND m.valid_from = DATE '2026-09-25'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC
